LinkedIn User.Title: Data Collection and Storage
LinkedIn User.Description: Implement functionalities to scrape first-level LinkedIn contacts, create an ignore list using NLP, store conversation history, and upload data for personalized messaging. This includes creating a UI for managing the ignore list and storing all data in local JSON files.

User Stories.Title: Scrape First-Level Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to scrape my first-level LinkedIn contacts and save their information (Name, Profile URL, Profile Image URL, Title) into Contacts.json so that I can have a local record of my connections.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should successfully scrape first-level LinkedIn contacts.
The scraped data should include Name, Profile URL, Profile Image URL, and Title.
The data should be saved in a local JSON file named Contacts.json.

User Stories.Title: Create Ignore List Using NLP
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to create an ignore list using NLP (OpenAI) based on keywords (Location, Roles, Industries) so that irrelevant contacts are filtered out automatically.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should use NLP to evaluate contacts based on specified keywords.
Contacts matching the keywords should have their IsIgnore key set to true.
The ignore list should be stored locally and be accessible for review and modification.

User Stories.Title: Manual Ignore List Management UI
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want a UI to manually manage the ignore list so that I can review and adjust the contacts filtered by NLP.
AcceptanceCriteria: The UI should display the list of contacts.
Users should be able to manually add or remove contacts from the ignore list.
Changes made through the UI should update the IsIgnore key in the contact data.

User Stories.Title: Store Conversation History
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to collect and store the conversation history with my LinkedIn contacts by navigating to each contact's message box and extracting exchanged messages into MessageHistory.json so that I can keep track of past interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should navigate to each contact's message box.
The conversation history should be extracted and stored in a local JSON file named MessageHistory.json.
The stored data should include the entire conversation history with each contact.

User Stories.Title: Create Campaigns with Filters
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want a UI to create a list of contacts I want to target using filters (Industry, Corporate Level, Role) and save this list under a new Campaign ID so that I can organize my outreach efforts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The UI should allow users to apply filters to their contact list.
Filtered contacts should be saved under a new Campaign ID.
The campaign data should be stored locally and be accessible for further interactions.

User Stories.Title: Set System Contexts for Campaigns
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to set the system contexts for the Profile Analyzer Transformer, Icebreaker Message Transformer, and Follow-up Message Transformer so that the generated messages are specialized for my campaign.
AcceptanceCriteria: The UI should allow users to set system contexts for transformers.
The system contexts should be saved and applied to the respective transformers.
The settings should be specific to each campaign.

User Stories.Title: View Historical Campaigns
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to view historical campaigns so that I can review past outreach efforts and their results.
AcceptanceCriteria: The UI should display a list of historical campaigns.
Users should be able to select and view details of each campaign.
Campaign data should include filters applied, contacts targeted, and messages sent.

User Stories.Title: Upload PDFs for Personalized Messaging
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to store PDFs in a static folder for use in attaching them to my personalized messages so that I can provide additional information to my contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users should be able to upload PDFs to a designated static folder.
The uploaded PDFs should be accessible for attachment in personalized messages.
The system should support multiple PDFs for different campaigns.

User Stories.Title: Store Specialized Data for Messaging
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to store a PDF containing specialized data to help personalize the messaging system further so that my outreach is more effective.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users should be able to upload a specialized data PDF to a designated folder.
The data from the PDF should be used to personalize messages.
The system should ensure the data is accessible and integrated into the message generation process.

LinkedIn User.Title: Contact Analysis and Message Generation
LinkedIn User.Description: Develop features to analyze LinkedIn contact profiles using OpenAI NLP, generate personalized initial and follow-up messages based on conversation history and profile analysis, and store these messages with approval tracking keys.

User Stories.Title: Profile Analysis Using OpenAI NLP
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to analyze my LinkedIn contacts' profiles using OpenAI NLP based on my preferences so that I can get insights and store the analysis results in the relevant contact data.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should analyze LinkedIn contact profiles using OpenAI NLP.
The analysis should be based on user-defined preferences.
The analysis results should be stored in the relevant contact data, taking into account the Campaign ID.

User Stories.Title: Generate Personalized Initial Outreach Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to generate personalized initial outreach messages using OpenAI based on conversation history, user data, and contact profile analysis so that I can effectively engage with my contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should generate personalized initial outreach messages using OpenAI.
The messages should be based on conversation history, user data, and contact profile analysis.
The messages should be stored with an IsInitialMessageApproved key to track approval, taking into account the Campaign ID.

User Stories.Title: Generate Personalized Follow-Up Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to generate personalized follow-up outreach messages using OpenAI based on conversation history, user data, and contact profile analysis so that I can maintain engagement with my contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should generate personalized follow-up outreach messages using OpenAI.
The messages should be based on conversation history, user data, and contact profile analysis.
The messages should be stored with an IsFollowUpMessageApproved key to track approval, taking into account the Campaign ID.

User Stories.Title: Store Generated Messages with Approval Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to store generated initial and follow-up messages with approval tracking keys so that I can review and approve them before sending.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should store generated initial and follow-up messages with approval tracking keys.
The IsInitialMessageApproved key should be used for initial messages.
The IsFollowUpMessageApproved key should be used for follow-up messages.
The messages should be stored in a way that allows easy retrieval and review.

User Stories.Title: Message Approval UI
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want a UI to review and approve generated initial and follow-up messages so that I can ensure the messages meet my standards before they are sent.
AcceptanceCriteria: The UI should display generated initial and follow-up messages for review.
The user should be able to approve or reject messages.
The approval status should update the IsInitialMessageApproved or IsFollowUpMessageApproved key in the contact data.
The UI should be user-friendly and intuitive.

LinkedIn User.Title: User Interface for Message Approval
LinkedIn User.Description: Create a user-friendly interface for reviewing and approving generated messages. This UI should allow users to update the approval status of initial and follow-up messages, ensuring control over the communication being sent out.

User Stories.Title: Review Generated Initial Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to review generated initial messages so that I can ensure the content is appropriate before sending.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of generated initial messages, when I access the message approval UI, then I should see all initial messages awaiting approval.
When I click on a message, then I should see the full content of the message.
When I approve a message, then the message status should be updated to 'Approved'.
When I reject a message, then the message status should be updated to 'Rejected' and I should have the option to edit the message.

User Stories.Title: Review Generated Follow-Up Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to review generated follow-up messages so that I can ensure the content is appropriate before sending.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of generated follow-up messages, when I access the message approval UI, then I should see all follow-up messages awaiting approval.
When I click on a follow-up message, then I should see the full content of the message.
When I approve a follow-up message, then the message status should be updated to 'Approved'.
When I reject a follow-up message, then the message status should be updated to 'Rejected' and I should have the option to edit the message.

User Stories.Title: Edit Generated Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to edit generated messages so that I can customize the content before sending.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a message awaiting approval, when I click on 'Edit', then I should be able to modify the message content.
When I save the edited message, then the changes should be reflected in the message content.
When I approve the edited message, then the message status should be updated to 'Approved'.

User Stories.Title: Filter Messages by Approval Status
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to filter messages by their approval status so that I can easily manage messages that need attention.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of messages, when I access the message approval UI, then I should see options to filter messages by 'Pending', 'Approved', and 'Rejected' statuses.
When I select a filter option, then only messages matching the selected status should be displayed.

User Stories.Title: Bulk Approve or Reject Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to bulk approve or reject messages so that I can efficiently manage multiple messages at once.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of messages, when I select multiple messages, then I should see options to 'Approve Selected' or 'Reject Selected'.
When I click 'Approve Selected', then the status of all selected messages should be updated to 'Approved'.
When I click 'Reject Selected', then the status of all selected messages should be updated to 'Rejected'.

User Stories.Title: View Message Approval History
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to view the approval history of messages so that I can track changes and decisions made.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a message, when I access the message approval UI, then I should see an option to view the approval history.
When I click on 'View History', then I should see a log of all approval actions taken on the message, including timestamps and user actions.

LinkedIn User.Title: Campaign Management
LinkedIn User.Description: Build functionalities for users to create and manage campaigns, filter contacts by various criteria, set system contexts for transformers, and view historical campaigns. This includes a UI for campaign creation and management.

User Stories.Title: Create Campaign
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to create a campaign so that I can target specific contacts for outreach.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the Campaigns page, when I click on 'Create New Campaign', then I should be able to enter a campaign name and description.
Given I have entered the campaign details, when I click 'Save', then the campaign should be created and saved with a unique Campaign ID.

User Stories.Title: Filter Contacts for Campaign
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to filter my contacts by industry, corporate level, and role so that I can create a targeted list for my campaign.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am creating a campaign, when I select filters for industry, corporate level, and role, then the system should display a list of contacts matching those criteria.
Given I have selected my filters, when I click 'Apply Filters', then the filtered list of contacts should be saved under the new Campaign ID.

User Stories.Title: Set System Contexts for Transformers
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to set system contexts for the Profile Analyzer, Icebreaker Message, and Follow-up Message Transformers so that the messages are tailored to my campaign.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am creating or editing a campaign, when I navigate to the 'System Contexts' section, then I should be able to set the contexts for the Profile Analyzer, Icebreaker Message, and Follow-up Message Transformers.
Given I have set the system contexts, when I save the campaign, then the contexts should be stored and associated with the Campaign ID.

User Stories.Title: View Historical Campaigns
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to view my historical campaigns so that I can review past outreach efforts and their results.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the Campaigns page, when I click on 'View Historical Campaigns', then I should see a list of all past campaigns with their names and creation dates.
Given I am viewing the list of historical campaigns, when I click on a specific campaign, then I should see the details of that campaign, including the list of contacts and messages sent.

User Stories.Title: Edit Campaign
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to edit an existing campaign so that I can update its details or contact list.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a campaign, when I click on 'Edit Campaign', then I should be able to modify the campaign name, description, filters, and system contexts.
Given I have made changes to the campaign, when I click 'Save', then the updates should be saved and reflected in the campaign details.

User Stories.Title: Delete Campaign
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to delete a campaign so that I can remove outdated or unnecessary campaigns from my list.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a campaign, when I click on 'Delete Campaign', then I should see a confirmation prompt asking if I am sure I want to delete the campaign.
Given I confirm the deletion, when I click 'Yes', then the campaign should be deleted and removed from the list of campaigns.

LinkedIn User.Title: Managing Potential Contacts
LinkedIn User.Description: Implement features to create new contact lists based on specific criteria from LinkedIn searches, invite potential contacts programmatically, and track the status of these invitations. This includes storing potential contacts in a local JSON file and recording invite dates.

User Stories.Title: Create Potential Contact Lists
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to create new contact lists based on specific criteria (Job Title, Region) from LinkedIn searches so that I can organize and manage potential contacts efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have performed a LinkedIn search, when I specify criteria such as Job Title and Region, then the system should create a new contact list and save it in PotentialContacts.json.
Given the contact list is created, when I view the list, then I should see all potential contacts matching the specified criteria.

User Stories.Title: Store Potential Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to store potential contacts in a local JSON file so that I can access and manage them later.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new contact list is created, when the system saves the list, then all potential contacts should be stored in PotentialContacts.json with relevant details such as Name, Profile URL, and Job Title.

User Stories.Title: Record Invite Dates
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to record the invite dates for potential contacts so that I can track when invitations were sent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a potential contact is invited, when the invitation is sent, then the system should record the invite date in PotentialContacts.json under the InviteDate key.

User Stories.Title: Invite Potential Contacts Programmatically
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to invite potential contacts programmatically so that I can automate the process of expanding my network.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of potential contacts, when I initiate the invitation process, then the system should send connection requests to each contact programmatically.
Given the invitations are sent, when I check the status, then the system should confirm that the invites were sent and update the InviteDate key accordingly.

User Stories.Title: Track Invitation Status
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to track the status of my invitations so that I can follow up with contacts who have not responded.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a potential contact has been invited, when I view the contact list, then I should see the status of each invitation (e.g., Pending, Accepted, Not Responded).
Given an invitation is pending, when one week has passed, then the system should flag the contact for follow-up actions.

User Stories.Title: Follow-Up on Pending Invitations
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to follow up on pending invitations via LinkedIn Sales Navigator so that I can increase the chances of connecting with potential contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invitation is pending for more than one week, when I initiate a follow-up, then the system should use Sales Navigator InMail credits to send a follow-up message.
Given the follow-up message is sent, when I check the contact list, then the system should update the status and save the follow-up message details.

LinkedIn User.Title: Automated Follow-Up and Outreach
LinkedIn User.Description: Develop functionalities to send follow-up messages automatically if no response is received to the initial message after 48 hours, track pending invitations, and use LinkedIn Sales Navigator for outreach to invited contacts who haven't accepted the connection request.

User Stories.Title: Send Automated Follow-Up Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want the system to automatically send follow-up messages if no response is received to the initial message after 48 hours so that I can ensure timely follow-ups without manual intervention.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an initial message is sent, when no response is received after 48 hours, then the system should automatically generate and send a follow-up message.
The follow-up message should use the conversation history as context.
The follow-up message should be stored with an 'IsFollowUpMessageApproved' key to track approval.

User Stories.Title: Track Pending Invitations
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to track pending invitations so that I can identify contacts who have not accepted my connection request after one week.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a connection request is sent, when one week has passed without acceptance, then the system should flag the invitation as pending.
The system should display a list of pending invitations in the UI.
The pending invitations should be stored with an 'InviteDate' key to track the date of the invitation.

User Stories.Title: Initiate Follow-Up via LinkedIn Sales Navigator
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to initiate follow-up actions via LinkedIn Sales Navigator for contacts who haven't accepted my connection request so that I can increase the chances of connecting with them.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contact has not accepted the connection request after one week, when the user initiates a follow-up, then the system should use Sales Navigator InMail credits to send a follow-up message.
The follow-up message should be personalized and stored in the system.
The system should save the sent messages and update the contact's status accordingly.

User Stories.Title: Generate Personalized Follow-Up Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want the system to generate personalized follow-up messages using OpenAI based on conversation history, user data, and contact profile analysis so that my follow-up messages are relevant and effective.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should use OpenAI to generate personalized follow-up messages.
The generated messages should take into account the conversation history, user data, and contact profile analysis.
The messages should be stored with an 'IsFollowUpMessageApproved' key to track approval.

User Stories.Title: Review and Approve Follow-Up Messages
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to review and approve generated follow-up messages so that I can ensure they meet my standards before being sent.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should provide a UI for reviewing generated follow-up messages.
The user should be able to approve or edit the messages.
The approval status should be updated in the contact data with an 'IsFollowUpMessageApproved' key.

LinkedIn User.Title: Dashboard and Settings Management
LinkedIn User.Description: Design a modern dashboard to display key metrics such as the total number of contacts and messages sent. Implement a settings section where users can adjust message sending limits, invitation limits, follow-up message limits, and provide necessary inputs like OpenAI API key and Chrome browser path.

User Stories.Title: Display Total Number of Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to see the total number of contacts on the dashboard so that I can quickly assess my network size.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays the total number of LinkedIn contacts.
The contact count is updated in real-time or upon refreshing the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Display Total Number of Messages Sent
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to see the total number of messages sent on the dashboard so that I can track my outreach efforts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays the total number of messages sent.
The message count is updated in real-time or upon refreshing the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Adjust Message Sending Limits
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to adjust the number of messages sent per day in the settings so that I can control my outreach volume.
AcceptanceCriteria: The settings section includes an input field to set the daily message sending limit.
The input value is saved and applied to control the number of messages sent per day.

User Stories.Title: Adjust Invitation Sending Limits
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to adjust the number of invitations sent per day in the settings so that I can manage my connection requests.
AcceptanceCriteria: The settings section includes an input field to set the daily invitation sending limit.
The input value is saved and applied to control the number of invitations sent per day.

User Stories.Title: Adjust Follow-Up Message Limits
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to adjust the number of follow-up messages sent per day in the settings so that I can manage my follow-up communication.
AcceptanceCriteria: The settings section includes an input field to set the daily follow-up message sending limit.
The input value is saved and applied to control the number of follow-up messages sent per day.

User Stories.Title: Provide OpenAI API Key
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to input my OpenAI API key in the settings so that the application can use NLP features.
AcceptanceCriteria: The settings section includes an input field for the OpenAI API key.
The API key is securely saved and used for NLP functionalities.

User Stories.Title: Provide Chrome Browser Path
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to input the path to my Chrome browser executable in the settings so that the application can perform browser automation tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: The settings section includes an input field for the Chrome browser executable path.
The path is saved and used for browser automation tasks.

User Stories.Title: View Dashboard Metrics
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to view key metrics on the dashboard so that I can monitor my LinkedIn activity at a glance.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays key metrics such as total contacts and total messages sent.
Metrics are visually presented in a user-friendly manner.

User Stories.Title: Save Settings Changes
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to save changes made in the settings so that my preferences are applied.
AcceptanceCriteria: The settings section includes a 'Save' button to apply changes.
Changes are saved and applied immediately or upon restarting the application.

User Stories.Title: Reset Settings to Default
User Stories.Description: As a LinkedIn User, I want to reset settings to their default values so that I can easily revert any changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: The settings section includes a 'Reset to Default' button.
Clicking the button resets all settings to their default values.
